report_kit_en: The local synthetic Kit chain passed with the same portable source identity: initial planning, independent verification, a single simulation-only ORDER_UPDATE, retention of v1 while v2 was pending, verified v2, original safe STOP, STOPPED/COMPLETE saving and confirmed native process exit 0. The installed Isaac Sim 6.1 runtime created a new private USD simulation. The launch retained the 900 s simulation wall budget and a separate two-hour test window with a 45-minute shutdown reserve. The saved v2 session reopened read-only and rendered 1,023 independently checked current intervals. This is one functional native run, with no paired Kit timing data or industrial speed qualification.
